description: Spending analysis and safe writes for Actual Budget: every delete previews and asks first.
name: io.github.henfrydls/actual-budget-mcp

environmentVariables.description: URL of your Actual Budget server, for example http://localhost:5006
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Password for your Actual Budget server. Not needed if you set ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Session token for servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use instead of ACTUAL_PASSWORD; if both are set, the token wins
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Your budget's Sync ID, found under Settings > Show advanced settings
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_ID

environmentVariables.description: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide every write tool from the model, exposing only reads and analysis
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local budget cache
environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_DATA_DIR

title: Actual Budget
